description: Read an existing report's definition, formulas, SQL, data sources, permissions, and resolved default scope. Accepts a report ID from list_insights_reports or the final UUID in an Insights URL. This returns the definition, not executed data. Call query_insights_report for data and explain the results directly to the user.

reportId.description: Report file ID from list_insights_reports, or the final UUID in its Insights URL.

name: get_insights_report
title: Get Insights report
